newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 27.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on January 27. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Pertamina president-director Faisal Abda'oe was optimistic projected government revenues from oil and gas in the 1996/97 budget of 14.2 trillion rupiah would be exceeded.

- Moslem scholar Abrurrahman Wahid has warned against the development of human resources for the sake of national development alone, citing a growing socia lapathy as the result of obsession with this goal.
- Indonesian and foreign businesspeople were nervously awaiting news on the status of the preshipment inspection system for imports with a new customs law taking effect in April.
- PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa planned to sell 20 percent of its stake in PT Indofood Sukses Makmur.

- PT Bimantara Citra said it was planning to sell its stake in PT Intirub to firm which focuses on the tyre industry. Bimantara has a 37.5 percent in Intirub, PT Astra International 32.5 percent, and the rest held by the government.
- Muhammad "Bob" Hasan, head of PT Nusantara Ampera Abadi (Nusamba) denied rumours in the stock market that he was planning to acquire a stake in plywood giant PT Barito Pacific Timber Company
- PT Bogasari Flour Mills said it planned to produce a special type of flour for export and domestic consumption by importing special wheat.
